newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Sweden's repo rate set unchanged at 4.10 pct.
newsitem.headline: Sweden's repo rate set unchanged at 4.10 pct.

text.p: Sweden's central bank, the Riksbank, on Tuesday left its key interest rate, the repo rate, at an unchanged 4.10 percent at its weekly operation.
The one-week reverse repurchase operation will run from February 19 to February 26.
A Reuters poll of 12 economists found none had expected the Riksbank to change its repo rate.
The repo rate is the bank's key tool for controlling money market liquidity.
It was last cut on December 17.
The bank's other key rates, the deposit and lending rates, currently stand at 3.75 percent and 5.25 percent respectively.
